name: adr-planning
details: While you plan a feature, records each decision that is hard to reverse as a short, numbered ADR in docs/adr/, briefs you on it, and records whether you accept or reject it. Accepted ADRs aren't edited: changing your mind means a new ADR that supersedes the old one.

name: code-review
details: Reviews the diff before you commit, with fresh eyes rather than from the memory of the agent that wrote it, and reports findings ranked by severity. Also runs when you ask for a review of a branch or PR, or when the commit gate asks for one.

name: doc-sync
summary: Keep docs true to the code
details: Before a commit that changes code, finds the docs that describe what changed (READMEs, guides, mermaid diagrams, links to ADRs) and edits them to match. It corrects what is there rather than appending, so the docs stay true.

name: project-init
summary: Start a project: git, AGENTS.md, PROJECT.md
details: Starts a new project from your agent: asks what the project is called and what it is for, sets up git and a remote if you have one, and writes PROJECT.md, AGENTS.md, and a CLAUDE.md that imports it. Every question can be skipped.

name: ship
details: When you say "ship it", runs code-review and doc-sync on your change, writes the commit message, and commits, so the commit gate has nothing left to ask. Runs only when you ask for it, never for a plain "commit this".

name: code-reviewer
details: A Claude Code subagent that code-review can hand the diff to, so the review runs in a fresh context that didn't write the code. Read-only: it reports findings and never edits files.

name: doc-auditor
details: A Claude Code subagent that doc-sync can hand the audit to: it checks the docs against the diff and reports drift, stale diagrams, broken ADR links, and missing docs. Read-only: it never edits files.

name: commit-gate
details: A git pre-commit hook that stops a commit whose diff hasn't been reviewed, or that changes code without touching any doc, and says to run code-review and doc-sync first. It also stops edits to Accepted ADRs outside their Status. git commit --no-verify skips it.

name: adr-index
summary: List Accepted ADRs at session start
details: A Claude Code hook that lists the project's Accepted ADRs when a session starts, so the agent knows which decisions hold before it changes code. Ships with the plugin only.
